# Scenario: DNS preflight skip — empty dig +short skips ACME for this cycle only.
# No retry bump, no mode downgrade, no .installedCert; apps still come up.
# ACME is pointed at a closed port so a broken dig stub cannot accidentally issue.

cd git-repo
exec git init -b main
exec git config user.email 'test@apinfra.local'
exec git config user.name 'Test Agent'
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'feat: dns preflight skip fixture'
cd ..

cp .apinfra.template .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'

# dig stub returns no answers → preflight fails before ACME.
chmod 0755 bin/dig
env PATH=$WORK/bin:$PATH

exec apinfra
stderr 'skip cert issue name=e2e-dns.apinfra.test'
stderr 'returned no IPs'
stderr 'done duration='
! stderr 'obtain primary'
! stderr 'cert issued'

! exists $HOME/infra/certbot/conf/live/e2e-dns.apinfra.test/fullchain.pem
! exists $HOME/.retries
! exists $HOME/.downgradeCertMode
! exists $HOME/.installedCert
! exists $HOME/.events
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-web-web-1

-- .apinfra.template --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main
certs.provider=letsencrypt
certs.letsencrypt.directory=https://127.0.0.1:1/directory
certs.letsencrypt.stagingDirectory=https://127.0.0.1:1/directory
certIssueTimeout=10s

-- git-repo/dev/settings.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-web
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        domain-name: e2e-dns.apinfra.test
      target:
        service-name: web
        port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: prod
      cert-acme-email: e2e@apinfra.local

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-web/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=OK"]
    container_name: e2e-web-container

-- bin/dig --
#!/bin/sh
# Empty dig +short → skip issuance (no retry / no downgrade).
exit 0

-- .env --
